entries.reason: iOS 26.2 is what the SDK 26.2 header gives this constant, API_AVAILABLE(ios(26.2)) at HKTypeIdentifiers.h of 26.2, and the corpus ledger's introduced agrees with that annotation for it. It is also where no rung of the held ladder exports the symbol, its last rung being 18.0, so the registry's own 26.2 places it: the object that defines it is HKConstants262.m
entries.effect: the value Apple ships, measured: the symbol read out of the host's own HealthKit is the string HKCategoryTypeIdentifierHypertensionEvent, which is this constant's own name
entries.source: the constant's value: dlsym of this symbol out of /System/Library/Frameworks/HealthKit.framework/HealthKit on macOS 26A428, decoded through CFStringGetCString as UTF-8, recorded per constant in coordination/corpus/ledger/constant-values-HealthKit.tsv with that binary and that build on every row; the declaration and its availability are the SDK 26.2 header's own (HKTypeIdentifiers.h); the release is measured with tools/symbol-first-release.lua over the held ladder, which is the release check's own question
